modules.title: 任务列表怎样只留下符合条件的项目

items.title: 条件来自已有字段
items.text: “未完成”“本周”“负责人是我”对应任务本来就有的状态、日期和负责人字段；多个条件叠加时，界面应让用户看见当前限制了什么。

items.title: 结果应可恢复
items.text: 清除一个条件或重置全部筛选后，用户应能回到完整集合。没有结果时要说明是筛选条件造成，而不是让人误以为数据消失。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 筛选不是搜索或排序。搜索按输入词找候选，筛选按已有属性排除项目，排序只改变当前结果的先后顺序；例如“只看未完成”不会自动让最紧急的任务排在前面。

lessonPractice.title: 用户只想看“本周到期，而且还没完成”的任务。怎样处理最准确？

options.label: 同时选择“本周到期”和“未完成”，并显示这两个条件
options.feedback: 对。两个已知字段共同缩小任务集合，用户也能看见为什么有些任务没有出现。

options.label: 输入整句话，只按任务标题匹配
options.feedback: 标题未必包含“本周到期”或“未完成”，这会把结构化条件误当关键词。

options.label: 先按截止日期排序，再把已完成任务折叠到列表底部
options.feedback: 排序不会排除不符合条件的任务，只会改变它们出现的顺序。

en.title: A person wants only tasks due this week and not completed. Which design is most accurate?

options.label: Use two filters—due date is this week and status is incomplete—and show both as active above the list
options.feedback: Correct. Two known fields narrow the task set, and people can see why some tasks are absent.

options.label: Have the person type the full sentence and match only title text
options.feedback: Titles may not contain “due this week” or “incomplete”; that mistakes structured conditions for keywords.

options.label: Sort by due date so other tasks naturally disappear
options.feedback: Sorting does not remove items that fail a condition; it only changes their order.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请给任务列表加入“本周到期”和“未完成”两个筛选条件，并在列表上方显示当前生效条件，支持单独清除和全部重置。改完后验证条件组合、无结果和重置后恢复全部任务。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add This week and Incomplete filters to the task list. Show active conditions above the list and support clearing one or resetting all. Verify combined conditions, no results, and restoration of all tasks after reset.

learning.assumes: You have narrowed a shopping, task, or data list by status, price, or date.
learning.outcome: You can define a filter condition, read the active conditions, and distinguish filtering from search and sorting.

modules.title: How a task list keeps only items matching conditions

items.title: Conditions come from existing fields
items.text: Incomplete, this week, and assigned to me map to task status, date, and owner fields. When several conditions combine, the interface should show what currently limits the list.

items.title: Results should be recoverable
items.text: Clearing one condition or resetting all filters should return people to the full collection. An empty state should say conditions caused it, not imply the data vanished.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Filtering is not search or sorting. Search finds candidates from entered words, filtering excludes by existing properties, and sorting only changes the order of current results. For example, showing incomplete tasks does not automatically put the most urgent first.

distinctions.label: Search
distinctions.text: A {c:filter} narrows the current set with explicit conditions. {c:search} uses typed words to find possibly relevant content.
